title: 第三章聂小倩第十七章窦氏第十八章复仇
lines: 第三章聂小倩
宁采臣，浙江人。性情慷慨正直，廉洁自爱。常对人说：“平生不做亏心事，不怕半夜鬼敲门。”
这一年，他客居金华，住在北郊的一座寺庙里。寺中殿塔壮丽，但杂草丛生，久无人迹。东西两厢僧舍，门都虚掩着，只有南面一间小屋，门上新挂了一把锁。殿东角有一丛修竹，台阶下有个大水池，池中野藕丛生，已经开了花。
宁采臣很喜欢这里清静。正赶上学使来金华考核生员，城里房租昂贵，他便安心住了下来，只等考期。
白天，他在屋里读书，静悄悄的，连个说话的人都没有。傍晚时分，来了一个书生，住进了南面那间小屋。宁采臣过去见礼，两人说了几句话。那书生自称姓燕，字赤霞，陕西人，性情豪爽耿直。两人谈得投机，便结为朋友。
当夜，月色初上，宁采臣正躺在榻上假寐。忽听屋北有低声私语，像是一男一女在说话。他悄悄爬起来，趴在窗下偷看——
短墙外，一个小院。一个四十多岁的妇人从屋里出来，穿着红衣服，头上插着梳子，像是大户人家的嬷嬷。她对着院子北面低声唤道：“小倩，出来。”
过了许久，一个十七八岁的女子从屋后转出来，容貌艳丽，身姿婀娜，月光下看不太真切，只觉眉眼间有一团雾气似的。
妇人笑着说：“背地里不说人。小倩，你心里是不是在念叨我？”
女子说：“姥姥，我是不是在念叨你，你不知道吗？”
妇人又说：“小倩，你的模样越发好了。赶明儿个，给你找个好人家，如何？”
女子没应声。
妇人又说了几句闲话，便带着女子走了。
宁采臣以为邻舍家眷，也没放在心上，翻个身睡了。
刚要睡着，忽然觉得有人进了他的屋子。他急忙睁眼一看——是那个叫小倩的女子。她站在床前，笑盈盈地看着他。
宁采臣问：“你做什么？”
女子不说话，只笑着。
宁采臣正色道：“夜深了，男女有别，请出去。若是被人看见，你我名声都不好。”
女子退了一步，还是不走。
她又凑近些，从袖中摸出一锭金子，放在榻上。
宁采臣把金子抓起来，扔到门外，喝道：“不义之财，弄脏了我的屋子！”
女子满面羞惭，拾起金子，退了出去，嘴里喃喃地说：“这个汉子，真是铁石心肠。”
【天书一笔】
小倩出门时，低头看了一眼自己的手。
手心里有一团淡淡的黑气，像墨汁滴在清水里，散开了一点点。
这团黑气跟了她很多年了。每害一个人，黑气就深一分。每被拒绝一次，黑气就淡一分。她不知道这是什么。但方才宁采臣把金子扔出去的时候，那团黑气像是被什么东西烫了一下，猛地缩了一圈。
她心里忽然涌上一阵说不清的感觉——不是怕，不是恼，是一种很陌生的、像是很久很久以前才有的东西。
她记不清那是什么了。
第二天，宁采臣去城里办事，晚上才回来。一进门，见燕赤霞坐在廊下等他。
“你昨天夜里看见什么了？”燕赤霞问。
宁采臣把夜里的事说了。
燕赤霞说：“那女子是鬼。那妇人是妖。你若不贪色不贪财，她们奈何不了你。但此处不可久留。我住的那间屋子，墙上有符，她们进不来。你若害怕，可以搬来与我同住。”
宁采臣说：“我不怕。”
过了两夜，小倩又来了。这一次，她不笑也不说话，一进门就跪下了。
宁采臣皱眉：“你又来做什么？”
小倩说：“公子，我不是来害你的。我有话说。”
“你说。”
“公子有所不知。这寺里住着一个夜叉，叫姥姥。它害人无数，方圆百里的过路人，不知被它害了多少。我本是一个良家女子，十八岁那年死了，葬在这寺后面，被它胁迫，做了害人的勾当。它让我以色相引诱过路之人，若那人贪色，便取他性命；若那人贪财，便取他心肝。”
她抬起头，看着宁采臣。
“我在这里三年，害了不下三十人。只有公子，既不贪色，也不贪财，是真正的正直之人。公子身上的正气，比任何符咒都管用。姥姥怕你，不敢来。但它不会放过你的。它让我来求你——求你离开这里。”
宁采臣问：“它为何要害我？”
小倩说：“它怕你。你的正气压着它，让它不能出来害人。你若不走，它迟早会动手。”

Chapter 3 Nie Xiaoqian
Ning Caichen is from Zhejiang. Generous and upright temperament, honest and self-loving. I often say to people: "If you don't do anything bad in your life, you won't be afraid of ghosts knocking on your door in the middle of the night."
This year, he stayed in Jinhua and lived in a temple in the northern suburbs. The tower in the middle hall of the temple is magnificent, but it is overgrown with weeds and has been deserted for a long time. The doors to the east and west side of the monk's residence are all ajar, except for a small room on the south side, with a new lock on the door. There is a clump of bamboo in the east corner of the hall, and there is a large pool under the steps. There are wild lotus roots in the pool and they are already blooming.
Ning Caichen likes the tranquility here very much. Just in time for the scholar to come to Jinhua to examine the students, the rent in the city was expensive, so he settled down and waited for the examination period.
During the day, he was studying in the house, quietly, with no one talking. In the evening, a scholar came and stayed in the small house on the south side. Ning Caichen went over to see him and the two exchanged a few words. The scholar claimed that his surname was Yan and his courtesy name was Chixia. He was from Shaanxi and had a forthright and upright temperament. The two struck up a good conversation and became friends.
That night, when the moonlight began to rise, Ning Caichen was lying on the couch taking a nap. Suddenly I heard whispers from the north of the house, like a man and a woman talking. He quietly got up and lay under the window to peek——
Outside the short wall, there is a small courtyard. A woman in her forties came out of the house, wearing red clothes and a comb in her hair. She looked like a nun from a wealthy family. She whispered to the north of the yard: "Xiaoqian, come out."
After a long time, a 17 or 18-year-old woman came out from behind the house. She had a beautiful face and graceful figure. It was hard to see clearly under the moonlight, but she felt like there was a mist between her eyebrows.
The woman smiled and said, "I don't tell anyone behind my back. Xiaoqian, are you thinking about me?"
The woman said: "Grandma, don't you know if I am talking about you?"
The woman then said, "Xiaoqian, you are looking better and better. How about I find you a good family tomorrow?"
The woman didn't answer.
The woman chatted a few more words and then took the girl away.
Ning Caichen thought that the neighbor's family didn't care about them, so he turned over and fell asleep.
Just as he was about to fall asleep, he suddenly felt someone entering his house. He hurriedly opened his eyes and saw - it was the woman named Xiaoqian. She stood in front of the bed and looked at him with a smile.
Ning Caichen asked: "What do you do?"
The woman didn't speak, she just smiled.
Ning Caichen said seriously: "It's late at night. There are differences between men and women. Please go out. If you are seen by others, you and I will have a bad reputation."
The woman took a step back but still refused to leave.
She came closer, took out a piece of gold from her sleeve, and placed it on the couch.
Ning Caichen grabbed the gold, threw it outside the door, and shouted: "Ill-gotten wealth has soiled my house!"
The woman was ashamed, picked up the gold, and retreated, murmuring: "This man is really hard-hearted."
【One Stroke of Heavenly Book】
When Xiaoqian went out, she looked down at her hands.
There was a faint black air in the palm of my hand, like ink dripping in clear water, spreading out a little.
This black energy has been following her for many years. Every time you harm someone, the black energy becomes deeper. Every time you are rejected, your black energy becomes lighter. She didn't know what it was. But when Ning Caichen threw the gold out just now, the black air shrank suddenly as if it had been burned by something.
Suddenly there was an indescribable feeling in her heart - not fear, not annoyance, but a very strange thing that seemed to have only existed a long, long time ago.
She couldn't remember what it was.
The next day, Ning Caichen went to the city to do business and came back at night. As soon as he entered the door, he saw Yan Chixia sitting on the porch waiting for him.
"What did you see last night?" Yan Chixia asked.
Ning Caichen told what happened at night.
Yan Chixia said: "That woman is a ghost. That woman is a monster. If you are not greedy for sex or money, they can't do anything to you. But you can't stay here for a long time. The room I live in has a talisman on the wall and they can't get in. If you are afraid, you can move in with me."
Ning Caichen said: "I'm not afraid."
Two nights later, Xiaoqian came again. This time, she didn't smile or speak, and knelt down as soon as she entered the door.
Ning Caichen frowned: "What are you doing here again?"
Xiaoqian said: "Master, I'm not here to harm you. I have something to say."
"You said."
"Young master, you don't know something. There is a Yaksha living in this temple, called Grandma. It has harmed countless people, including passers-by for hundreds of miles around. I was originally a good-natured woman. I died when I was eighteen years old and was buried behind this temple. I was coerced by it and did harm to others. It asked me to use my appearance to seduce passers-by. If that person is greedy for sex, it will take his life; if that person is greedy for money, it will take his heart and liver."
She raised her head and looked at Ning Caichen.
"I have been here for three years and have killed no less than thirty people. Only the young master is neither greedy for sex nor money. He is a truly upright person. The righteousness in the young master is more effective than any charm. Grandma is afraid of you and dare not come. But it will not let you go. It asked me to come to beg you - please leave here."
Ning Caichen asked: "Why does it want to harm me?"
Xiaoqian said: "It's afraid of you. Your righteousness suppresses it and prevents it from harming others. If you don't leave, it will take action sooner or later."
